title: [maintainer] refactor(metadata-protocol): split `src/protocol.ts` (33,065 lines, +10,169 in 30 days) along its `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` seams, one move-only slice per PR
body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer dispatched, quoted verbatim below. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021) · `os-sales` · session `session_016g7nYP9wdNx1GDa5XDr7Uy`, as the `domain:engine` half of #24586's restart act. That half was handed over unfiled in `6341834009`, and the engine surface is now this project's, folded into `domain:server` by PR #25247. ⛔ Not a claim.

**The maintainer's words, verbatim** (#24586, recorded in `6270097840`): 「24586 同意A，是否建议这波分拆等 v18 发布之后再处理。」 Triage read the restart condition (npm `@objectstack/spec` `latest` ≥ 18.0.0) as true in `6291735609`. The ruling's restart act: "one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines into its owning lane … Each card starts with a fresh seam measurement taken at that time, in #23050's shape", and "`protocol.ts` goes first".

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` lane, engine surface (`packages/metadata-protocol` was `domain:engine`'s). One dispatch per slice.

## Measured (on `origin/main` `b2c0752900`, 2026-10-23)

- **Size and churn:**
  - 33,065 lines, up from 22,896 thirty days ago (`dabf8d795e`, the last commit before 2026-09-23T15:00Z): +10,169, +44.4%.
  - 28 commits in 7 days and 184 in 30 days.
  - `git blame --since=2026-09-23T15:00Z` attributes 13,445 lines (40.7%) to the last 30 days.
- **Structure:**
  - a 6,643-line module preamble: helpers, three error classes, and the query-param and filter vocabulary;
  - one `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` class, lines 6644–32941 (26,298 lines, 267 members);
  - a 124-line trailer of package-persist helpers.

  The sections, by contiguous member ranges:

| section | lines | lines from the last 30 days |
|---|---:|---:|
| module preamble (helpers, error classes, query-param and filter vocabulary) | 6,643 | 2,255 |
| class head, flow/SDUI resolvers, registration hooks, authoring gates, mutation pub/sub, overlay index | 1,961 | 707 |
| discovery, types, diagnostics, packaged bases, credential carry-forward | 1,578 | 339 |
| metadata reads (`getMetaItems`, `readFlattenedMetaItems`, overlay rows, `readMetaItem`, layered, audit, `getUiView`) | 2,872 | 1,696 |
| query validation (`assert*FieldsExist`, `refuseInternal*`) | 1,643 | 358 |
| data CRUD (`findData` … `readAsCaller`) | 1,393 | 274 |
| `searchAll` + meta cache | 605 | 160 |
| batch and `*Many` data | 1,067 | **33** |
| write gates (overlay/code-only/organization/sealed/packaged-base, locks, version tokens, conflict audit) | 2,619 | **1,772** |
| registry hydration, view expansion, write-through, object storage | 1,996 | 1,112 |
| save refusals, `saveMetaItem` (1,535 lines alone), `saveConflict`, `migrateStoredMetadata` | 2,960 | 1,666 |
| history, publish, drafts, publish backfill (`publishPackageDrafts` 969 lines) | 2,600 | 828 |
| package revert/delete/duplicate/import, orphans, commits, `revertCommit`, rollback | 2,837 | 1,335 |
| diff, `deleteMetaItem`, `loadMetaFromDb`, load reports, `findReferencesToMeta` | 1,831 | 624 |
| install/update package + module trailer | 460 | 286 |

- **Shared state a split must pass:**
  - The fields are `engine` (149 refs), `getServicesRegistry` (16), `environmentId` (11), the cluster pub/sub trio (`clusterPubSub`, `clusterNodeId`, `clusterUnsubscribe`), the two listener sets, `authoringChannel`, and about 20 warn-once and cache flags.
  - Coupling is mostly method-to-method: 597 `this.X(` calls over 206 distinct members. Reads, write gates and saves call one another across the sections above.
- **What reads it by path:**
  - **The ADR anchor file `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__metadata-protocol__src__protocol.ts.json`.** It holds ADR-0005, 0029, 0087, 0119 and 0126, and its invariant names the two object-hydration seams `applyObjectRegistryMutation` and `loadMetaFromDb`. The `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` anchor file and `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` also name the file.
  - **10 more files under `scripts/`:** `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`, `check-engine-double-contract.mjs` (+ `.pinned.json`, `.seams.json`), `check-filter-alias-parity.mjs`, `check-nul-bytes.mjs`, `check-system-context-census.mjs`, `docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`, `objectql-double-limit.baseline.json`, `query-options-erasure-baseline.json`.
  - **22 files under `docs/` and `content/`,** 11 of them ADRs.
  - **Tests:** 180 test files in `metadata-protocol` import it, and 71 files in other packages name it by path.
- **In flight:** none of the 21 open PRs touch the file.

## The ask (from #24586's ruling and #23050's shape)

1. **Split along the existing seams,** one area per PR. Each slice is **move-only**: no logic changes.
2. **Shared state stays explicit:** moved code reaches the class's shared members through one named context object (the host pattern of #23050, #25222, #25223 and #25224). ⛔ Not a second copy of a helper, ⛔ not a re-derivation.
3. **Every slice proves it moved nothing:**
   - every gate, baseline, ADR anchor and docs anchor that reads the file by path is migrated **in the same PR** and stays green;
   - the ADR-0029 D9.8/D9.9 invariant's two seams keep a resolving anchor;
   - the package's public `.d.ts` stays identical.
   - ⛔ A gate whose target moved must not go silently empty.
4. **Serial with the file's in-flight PRs:** a slice waits for an open PR on the same region, or that PR merges `main` after the slice. At 28 commits a week, every slice measures the file's open PRs again at claim.
5. ⛔ No new gate.

## Not in this card

- Any behaviour change.
- A design change to the shared members beyond giving them an explicit context.
- `objectql/src/engine.ts` (23,903 lines) and `driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (22,096 lines). They are the other two engine-surface files under the same ruling, and they are filed once this card's first slices have landed (#24586's order: `protocol.ts` first).
- `spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, which belongs to `domain:spec`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, with two queries:
- "split protocol.ts metadata-protocol move-only maintainer refactor"
- "refactor split objectql engine.ts sql-driver.ts large file"

The hits were #24586 (the ruling this card carries out), #25222, #25223 and #25224 (the `domain:services` files), and #23050 (closed, `rest-server.ts`). None covers `protocol.ts`. **New.**
